notes.title: 2.000.003 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Improved the experience of adding and removing bots to groups.

Cleaned up team select behavior.

Added the word "co-op" to the Graveyard Shift description in the main menu.

Improved the voice scrambler menu to avoid accidentally scrambling the whole room instead of one person.

Fixed an issue where Graveyard Shift was showing incomplete text in the UI.

Fixed various game crashes and compatibility issues.

notes.title: 1.2.1 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes

 Includes new PSPC SDK hopefully resolving some player's 1.49 errors.
 Fixed an issue where the lobby list could not be navigated to using gamepad.
 Potentially fixed some out of memory crashes on PC.

notes.title: Midnight Murder Club 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
Features:

New Wildcards

 Falling Chandelier – attach a chandelier to the ceiling that will fall on your enemies when they walk underneath it
 Flaming Skull – transform into a flaming, flying skull and hunt your enemies from the skies!
 Growing Glow Trail –We’ve updated Glowing Glow Trails so now they get longer with every kill
 Party Room – there ain’t no party like a Midnight Murder Party because the Midnight Murder Party don’t stop! Until everyone is dead. Then... Then it stops...
 Knives Only – by popular request, you gotta slash your enemies to bits
 Sound Blast: Jazz Club – every time you fire your gun it sounds like a high school band rehearsing
 Pinged to Death! – on a player’s death, a pinger goes off revealing the locations of everyone in the mansion
 Shrink Shot – get shot, get shrunk, get revenge 
 Gift from the Grave – when you die, you’ll get a little present that will give you a chance to catch up and seek revenge
 All in the Chamber – all your bullets fire at once. More bullets = More good!

Players can now play a Wildcards match with bots

Voice Scrambler: if you’re matched with someone who is being a bit of a jerk, you can now scramble their voice, so you can’t tell what they’re saying, but you can still tell where they are

Bots:

 Bots will now be better teammates
 Bots are now available in Wildcard matches

Balancing:

 Mansion Compass – helps you navigate when your flashlight is on
 Death Pin Drops – players will now see a ping that shows them the location of where they last died in the mansion, helping them find their way back

Other

 UI / UX flow updates to improve rematch capabilities and optimize grouping up with friends

Known Issues

 Players using a controller on PC will not be able to navigate to the right-side menu after pressing “Play Game.” The current workaround if players need to access that menu is to use mouse and keyboard.

notes.title: Play with the Devs
notes.content:
Next week, Friday, June 13th, come play with the Devs!Time: Friday, June 13th at 5pm ET / 4pm CT / 3pm PT
We'll be playing on a Private Branch that will give everyone the opportunity to try out new Wildcards and features before they're live!

In order to play, you'll need to:

Play on Steam (build download instructions will be posted here day-of)

Own the game

Live in North America (technically, you can join from other countries, but there may be lag)

Join our Discord: discord.gg/velanstudios

We'll be meeting in the Voice Chat channel called #JOIN THE PLAYTEST. Groups of 6 will be moved to separate rooms so their VC doesn't overlap with other teams. We'll try to get as many of you playing with devs as possible, but get there early for the best chance!

We'd love it if after the session, you could give us your thoughts on the new items you played with, but we also just want to make sure this a fun time, and an opportunity to meet other players and the team.
Pro Tip: This play session is only an hour long, so to get the most bang for your buck, hop in the Discord earlier in the day to find the build download instructions in #MMC-NEWS.


Here's a sneak peek at the Wildcards that will appear in this build:

Falling Chandelier Vendor: Add a fiery trap to the ceilings that will fall on your foes!

Flaming Skull Vendor: Take command of a flaming skull and light up the shadows!

All In The Chamber: Shoot every bullet in your gun at once!

Party Room: Who said disco was dead?

Pinged to Death: When an enemy dies, all players will be exposed in the darkness!

Shrink Shot: Get shot. Get shrunk. Get revenge!

Sound Blast: Jazz Club: Why not jazz up your gunshots?

Gift From the Grave: Earn a gift after every death!

Growing Glow Trails: The more kills you get, the longer your glow trail!

Footprint Trail: The more kills you get, the more footsteps you'll leave behind!

Knives Only: By popular demand, we finally have a knives only card!

notes.title: 1.0.402 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is a PC-only update that addresses a few small issues including the dreaded “black screen bug” and some of the 1.49 error codes players were seeing.

 Players are now informed if communication is restricted due to parental controls or PSN account penalties from previous behavior.
 Controller rumble is disabled to avoid a bug some players were experiencing.
 If you weren’t experiencing the black screen bug when starting the game, you can manually enable rumble by adding -audio_motion_enabled to Steam Launch Options (https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/7D01-D2DD-D75E-2955).
 Minor updates to PSPC runtime installer.
 Enabled PSN crash reporting.
 Updated PSPC SDK to 4.0.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.000.400
notes.content:
The game's first post-launch patch for all platforms is here! This update fixes a handful of issues on both PC and PS5 and also introduces a chaotic, new Wildcard into the mix, which can be unlocked from the random pool at the end of a Wildcards match just like the rest of the cards. With Shoot Through Walls active, nobody is safe. An extra deadly combo is pairing this with the Player Pinger, making snipes from across the mansion possible. Enjoy!

Patch Notes

 Added the Shoot Through Walls Wildcard to the array of cards players can unlock.
 Fixed an issue where Molotov Cocktails were disappearing after being thrown
 Fixed an issue where some players were getting stuck on a black screen instead of loading into a match.
 Fixed a crash that occurred for some PC players when joining a public lobby if that group was already matchmaking.
 Fixed an issue that was allowing players and bots to play in unsupported game modes.
 Fixed an issue with PSN accounts getting into a log in loop.‍

notes.title: Early Access Launch Patch Notes
notes.content:
Happy Early Access Launch Day!
Thank you for being part of our journey! The game is now available to download! Play a few rounds and let us know what you think!  Join our Discord to get the most up-to-date news, chat with the devs, and more.

Patch version 1.000.003 | Released: 3/13/25

New Features
Wildcards Game Mode
In this brand new game mode, we’re breaking all the rules! Each player chooses a card to dynamically change the game. Will yours be a curse… or a blessing? Try out different combinations for unexpected results! Shrink everyone down to 50% of their size, add a bullet proof vest to the Toy Vendor, or set everyone on fire if they stand still during the match… just to name a few!

Guest Pass Edition
Invite up to five of your friends to play Midnight Murder Club with you for no additional cost! Guest Pass Edition is a free* download that allows you to play all modes as often as you like, as long as you have a friend with the full edition hosting the lobby. Guest Pass players can play in private matches (With a paying host) or join matchmaking (with a paying host leading your party and being the one to join the matchmaking queue).
*You do need PS+ on PS5 to play, and there are some regions that can't list M-rating-equivalent downloads for free, so the cost legally has to be something like $0.25 or $1.00 or similar, but we're pricing it as low as we legally can in those regions.

Free-for-All and Team Deathmatch Bots
Want to keep exploring the mansion's shadows after your game night is over? Consider bots your fill-in friends when your entire party just can’t make it.  

Rematch
Get matched with some foes that keep you on your toes, and find yourself with a beef that can only be settled with another match? Now, in public matchmaking, bring the whole group back for another round… and another… and another…

Localization Support
English, German, French, Italian, EU Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, LATAM Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Korean

This is just the start, but we’ve got lots more in store! Here’s what you can expect from us in upcoming patches!

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Introducing: our Early Access Roadmap

Spend time in Wormwood Manor, and you'll find a great many secrets, including... a ✨magic✨ flashlight*. Shine its beam in the darkness of the cavernous hallways and great rooms, and you might find... a glimpse into the future. 🔦 

Lighting A Path Forward
We know you've been patiently waiting for news on the future of Midnight Murder Club and we're pleased to illuminate our current plan, featuring new Wildcards, PvE mode, new toys and custom games!

We invite you to be part of our evolutionary journey.  Join our Discord!  and help shape the future of the game!

*there is no magic flashlight, just the roadmap 🙃
